Green City Livestock Auction sold 42 head of 764 lb. steers for 410.50 and a load of 833 lb. steers for 387.50. Joplin Regional Stockyards sold 30 head of 861 lb. steers for 375.00 and 10 full loads (616 head) of 941 lb. steers at 362.00. Green City Livestock Auction sold 2 loads of 713 lb. heifers for 391.00. Due to the 4th of July no USDA reports were published on Friday. Boxed beef cut-out values were lower for the week as of Thursday's close. Choice closed on Thursday at 387.07, down 3.96 and Select closed at 367.43, down 4.15 compared to last week. The choice/select spread is at 19.64 per cwt. Negotiated feedlot sales as of the 2:00 cutoff time on Thursday was reported at 56K head. Live sales reported at 255.00-256.00 and dressed sales 403.00. The Missouri Stocker formula consists of 3158 head with a weighted average weight of 557.88 lbs. and a price value of 477.19, 0.91 higher than last week. The steer/heifer is 49.04 per cwt.
